samples.title: 2006 Nsogbu nri nke Horn of Africa
samples.excerpt:
N'afọ 2006, ụkọ nri siri ike metụtara mba ndị dị na Horn of Africa (Somalia, Djibouti na Etiopia), yana ugwu ọwụwa anyanwụ Kenya. Òtù Nri na Ọrụ Ugbo nke United Nations (FAO) mere atụmatụ na Jenụwarị 6, 2006, na ihe karịrị nde mmadụ iri na otu nọ na mba ndị a nwere ike imetụta ụnwụ nri na-abịanụ, nke a na-ekwu n'ụzọ dị ukwuu n'ihi oké ụkọ mmiri ozuzo, na esemokwu agha na mpaghara ahụ.

samples.title: Air Bissau
samples.excerpt:
Air Bissau bụ ụgbọelu akara mba Guinea Bissau site na 1960 ruo 1998. N'afọ ikpeazụ nke ọrụ ya, ọ naghị eji ụgbọelu nke ya, kama ọ na-agbazite ụgbọelu n'aka ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọelu ndị ọzọ.
Air Bissau n'oge afọ 1980 bụ nke Nzukọ Nnwere Onwe Ndị Palestine jikọtara na Maldives Airways. N'afọ 1991, Yasser Arafat nọ n'elu ụgbọelu Air Bissau Antonov AN-24 mgbe ọ dara n'ala aja, gbuo mmadụ atọ.
Ụgbọelu ahụ malitere ọrụ ya n'okpuru aha Transportes Aéreos da Guiné Portuguesa; mgbe Guinea Bissau nwetara nnwere onwe na 1974, a gbanwere aha ya ka Linhas Aéreas da Guiné-Bissau; n'etiti afọ 1980, a gbanwere ya ọzọ

samples.title: Anụ ọhịa nke North Carolina
samples.excerpt:
Isiokwu a na-achọ ije ozi dị ka onye nduzi, ebe nchekwa etiti, na ndepụta maka osisi na Anụmanụ nke steeti US nke North Carolina na mpaghara ndị gbara ya gburugburu.


== Ọnọdụ gburugburu ebe obibi nke steeti ==

A na-ekewa ala North Carolina n'ime ebe atọ: Coastal, Piedmont, na Appalachian Mountains.
North Carolina bụ steeti kachasị pụrụ iche na ndịda ọwụwa anyanwụ n'ihi na ókèala ya nwere ebe obibi sub-tropical, temperate, na boreal. Ọ bụ ezie na steeti ahụ dị na latitudes dị jụụ, Ugwu Appalachian na Gulf Stream na-emetụta ihu igwe na, ya mere, ahịhịa (flora) na anụmanụ (fauna).

samples.title: Asụsụ Wancho
samples.excerpt:
Wancho (वांचो) bụ asụsụ Konyak nke dị n'ebe ugwu-ọwụwa anyanwụ India . A na-asụ Wancho na obodo 36 dị na ndịda ọwụwa anyanwụ Longding district, Tirap district, Arunachal Pradesh, yana Assam na Nagaland ( Ethnologue ). Aha ndị ọzọ gụnyere Banpara Naga, Joboka, Jokoba.


== Ndị mmadụ ==
Ndị Wancho nwere ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ 56,866 na-asụ Wancho dịka nkwenye 2011 siri dị, ma bụrụkwa ndị bi na steeti India nke Arunachal Pradesh. Ọ bụ ezie na ha pere mpe, ndị bi na ya nwere ọdịbendị bara ụba nwere emume, emume emume, okpukperechi, na olumba dị iche iche nke Wancho.

samples.title: Demetrius Oliver
samples.excerpt:
Demetrius Oliver (amuru Maach 2, 1975) bu onye omenka na onye nkuzi nke America dabere na New York City.  [1] A mara ya maka nrụnye saịtị dị iche iche, ọtụtụ ihe na-eji foto, ihe ọkpụkpụ, na vidiyo. N'iji ihe ndị a na-ama ma oyiyi ihe oyiyi, ọrụ ya na-ekiri ndị dị ka American transcendentalism, egwu, na cosmology .   


== Ndụ mbido ==
Oliver natara BFA ya site na Rhode Island School of Design in Providence, Rhode Island na 1998. Ọ natara MFA ya na 2004 na Mahadum Pennsylvania dị na Philadelphia, Pennsylvania ebe ọ bụ nwa akwụkwọ Terry Adkins 


== Ọrụ ==
Oliver bụ onye na-ese ihe na-ebi na Sk

samples.title: Gretel Killeen
samples.excerpt:
Gretel Killeen (amụrụ na 3 Febụwarị 1963)  Ọ bụ onye na-egosi mmemme telivishọn Australia, onye ama ama n’ọrụ mgbasa ozi, onye na-eme ihe ọchị (comedian) na onye edemede. A ma ama ya nke ọma dịka onye na-anabata (host) mmemme Big Brother Australia site na mmalite ya n’afọ 2001 ruo oge mmemme 2007 (tinyere Celebrity Big Brother n’afọ 2002).  Killeen kwadoro 2009 TV Week Logie Awards .  N'oge na-adịbeghị anya, a mara ọkwa ya dị ka onye ọbịa ọhụrụ nke The Traitors Australia
